title: Agent Manager scanner rule
description: One YAML document per rule (R2). Rules are data: a new rule instance is a file, a new detection class is a new Go matcher plus a match.kind value. Rules never contain executable logic.

id.description: Stable and never reused, e.g. SH-NET-002.

check.description: Which registered Check consumes this rule.

detail.description: Prose shown in the finding pane. Explains why it is flagged, not just what matched.

kind.description: Selects the matcher. shell-ast walks mvdan.cc/sh syntax trees; regex is RE2 over instruction files; schema-path targets a JSON pointer; dep-manifest parses package.json / go.mod / requirements.txt.

pattern.description: regex: an RE2 pattern. Backtracking is impossible by construction.

pointer.description: schema-path: JSON pointer into the manifest or expected-capability document.

condition.description: Named predicate. Adding one is a Go change; using one is not.

fixtures.description: Every rule ships a bundle that must trip it and one that must not (constitution, Development Workflow). CI fails a rule with either missing.
